legacy.full_text: Hello from a mock timeline! Read more https://t.co/Link1 https://t.co/AbCdEf123

This is a deliberately long fixture post. It exists so the watch feed's clamping can be checked on a real screen: after a few lines the text should collapse to eight lines with a centred "Show more" button underneath, and tapping that button should expand the post in place without pushing the whole timeline into a reload.

The second paragraph makes the post long enough to be interesting. It keeps going for a while, in the way that a real announcement or a person explaining a bug might. Nothing in here is important, but the layout is: line spacing, margins, the separator under the post, and the fact that the action row stays reachable after expanding.

A third paragraph rounds it out past the 280-character threshold that the redesign uses as the other trigger for clamping. If this text appears in full the feed is not clamping; if it shows eight lines followed by Show more, the rule is working as intended.
